name: navigation-menu
title: Navigation Menu
description: A strip of triggers where each opens a morphing popup with a viewport that resizes between items. The popup is popup.content (the second consumer outside menus). The viewport morphs via the primitive's --popup-width/--popup-height CSS variables — no new popup member, no !important. Link renders Text.Link through render. The trigger's chevron rotates on open and sits on the inline end (ms-auto).
